requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. 0-2s: from the very first frame a thin layer of white foam washes across the surface and is rinsed away by a quick ripple of clear water, while the camera glides fast along the row of pores; in each pore the top of the plug shrinks only a little. 2-4s: the foam washes over and rinses away a second time, and again each plug gets a little smaller and looser, the black caps fading from black to grey. 4-6s: two more quick washes pass, each one taking away only a little more. 6-8s: the camera pulls back fast to show the whole row: the pore mouths are now open and clear, lined only by a thin amber film of oil, holding until the very last frame. The change is gradual, a small step with each wash, never sudden; the rest of the skin stays soft pale cyan. No human figure, no body, no face anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. Low ambient synth hum with a soft swish and a water ripple at each wash, no music, no dialogue.
